manifest_hash_note: data/index/manifest.json is hashed over its substantive fields only, excluding the wall-clock built_at_utc. The value originally recorded here was a raw-bytes hash (a8e173512dc1c6a0...), which cannot be stable across P0 runs and made --verify report drift for a rebuild that changed nothing. Corrected to the content hash; the release CSVs themselves were re-verified byte-identical at the same time.
